nodes.description: Loss of RAB39B disturbs alpha-synuclein homeostasis. Patients examined at post-mortem had widespread classic and cortical Lewy bodies, and the knockout mouse shows increased alpha-synuclein and oligomers in nigral dopaminergic neurons with nigral Lewy bodies. Knockdown in cultured cells, by contrast, lowered steady-state alpha-synuclein, so the direction of the change depends on the system.
